title: aristida adscensionis var. senegalensis
intro: Aristida adscensionis var. senegalensis, commonly known as Senegal six-angled grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aristida adscensionis var. senegalensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve cough, and soothe respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
